description: This file defines a React hook and context provider for managing a shopping cart in a furniture marketplace frontend. It includes types for cart items, functions to add, update, remove items, and calculate totals, as well as context initialization and storage synchronization using localStorage.

methods.name: useCart
methods.description: Custom hook to access the cart context ensuring it is used within a CartProvider

methods.name: CartProvider
methods.description: React component that provides cart state management and functions to its children via context
